open_points.subject: _encrypt_backup
open_points.text: - _encrypt_backup: [SECURITY_BOUNDARY] MUST seal under an AES-GCM key of the imported BACKUP_KEY_BYTES constant in bytes, derived by HKDF with the hash the imported hashes.SHA256 constructor of the cryptography package builds, the one whose name the imported BACKUP_KEY_DERIVATION_HASH constant holds, and no salt from the bytes of backup_key with those of the imported BACKUP_KEY_DERIVATION_INFO constant as its info, both encoded by the imported TEXT_ENCODING constant, using the cryptography package, and MUST pass the record line's bytes without its line feed as the associated data, so that a changed record fails the decryption.
open_points.rule: Нота остаётся требованием к поведению: выражения, вызовы методов, точечная навигация и строковый микро-синтаксис в ней запрещены.
open_points.question: The passage must name a directly imported constructor symbol without the dotted navigation `hashes.SHA256`, with the corresponding direct import added to IMPORTS.

open_points.subject: _encrypt_backup
open_points.text: - _encrypt_backup: [VALIDATION_ERROR] MUST raise ValueError, a wiring fault and never an answer, when the name of the hash hashes.SHA256 built for the key's derivation is not the one the imported BACKUP_KEY_DERIVATION_HASH constant holds, a release whose constant names another hash being one this code was not made for.
open_points.rule: Нота остаётся требованием к поведению: выражения, вызовы методов, точечная навигация и строковый микро-синтаксис в ней запрещены.
